Title: Weapon evolutions, full controller support and fresher runs
Changes: Weapon evolutions: a max-level weapon plus its catalyst offers a gold EVOLUTION card. There are 24, and the Codex records the ones you find.
New Puzzle route: a short puzzle map, different every run, before each map. Six kinds of rooms, hints, a skip portal, and medals that pay prizes for the next fight. Works in co-op.
Full controller support: stick look, menus, rebinding, and hints that follow your bindings and device.
Land maps now have their own enemies, and the boss order changes from run to run.
Reroll, banish and skip refill as you reach new maps. Lucky Shell, Tome of Multitudes and easy Pearl modifiers were rebalanced.
Co-op difficulty now scales with the number of players.
Endless draws new maps every loop and adds a random twist from loop 2.
New accessibility options: colour-blind palettes and reduced flashes. Classic has a short first-run tutorial.
Safer saves, and co-op now refuses players on a different version with a clear message. All players must update together.
